Delayed path uses routed individual outer datagrams and 2250 us delay per direction, zero injected loss; loopback has no delay/loss. Fresh daemons per phase, persistent across ascending rates. Sequential production/rolling/packed/empty/quantum/production controls. Candidates remain experimental; this is not an acceptance result.
